name: Torrential Gearhulk
oracle_text:
Flash
When this creature enters, you may cast target instant card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, you may cast target instant card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

needs.what: the `exiles: true` rider (StackItem.exiles_instead, 'if that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead') on a free resolution-time cast of a targeted card in a graveyard -- e.g. an `exiles` key on `cast_from_hand` passed through to cast_for_free(exiles_instead=...) when its `objects` names a target, so the optional free cast of target instant card from your graveyard has the spell exiled however it leaves the stack (resolving, fizzling, countered)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cast_card` takes `exiles` but always charges the card's mana cost (_cast_paying_mana_cost), missing 'without paying its mana cost'. `cast_from_hand` with `objects: {target: t1}` casts free and optionally from the graveyard but its options are only objects/per_owner/player/selector/zones, with no `exiles`, so the instant would return to the graveyard. `play_exiled` has free + `exiles` but defaults `exiled_with: self` on any non-binding pool and is mandatory, so a graveyard target matches nothing. Same gap as Impulsivity.
